constraints.description: Two authorized generated v2 clients receive committed mutations through PostgreSQL, Iggy, the durable typed projection, and tonic while out-of-scope or denied payloads do not cross the application boundary.

validation.validation_method: owned real-adapter tonic scenario plus cross-scope application regression

constraints.description: Snapshot/live races, signed resume, expired history, lag, cancellation, token or authority revocation, and teardown follow ADR-010.

validation.validation_method: deterministic race and recovery tests plus live resume scenario

constraints.description: Snapshot rows come from current durable typed projection state at an inclusive source/broker cursor and live replay starts strictly after it.

validation.validation_method: SurrealDB typed snapshot and race scenario

constraints.description: The frozen v1 proto remains unchanged; generated v2 tonic client and server compile and interoperate.

validation.validation_method: v1 hash evidence, generated client compile, real tonic call

constraints.description: Formatting, diff hygiene, file size, focused tests, deployment profiles, all-target checks, strict Clippy, strict OpenSpec validation, and independent adversarial review pass locally.

global_rules: Runtime tests execute locally; CI results are not evidence.
Every adapter implements exactly one port and composition remains in the gateway.
Every protected payload is authorized at admission and object delivery time.
Every hand-authored file remains at most 500 lines.
The fixture owns and removes every external resource it creates.
termination_conditions: Independent adversarial review has no unresolved critical or warning finding.
